resources.string: HealthStream is a health-tracking app. To display the full history and trends of your conditions, it can read and write data in Health Connect — the secure system storage for medical data on Android.

HealthStream solely performs collecting, storing and visualizing the user\'s physiological indicators. The app does not provide medical advice, does not interpret data for diagnosis purposes and does not prescribe treatment. All charts, statistics and reports are purely informational. If you feel unwell or have any health-related questions, always consult a doctor.

When you export or send generated reports (PDF/CSV), you do so at your own discretion. The app and the developer bear no responsibility for their further distribution, transfer to third parties, preservation or use outside the app.
Heart-rate values obtained from wearable devices and sensors, to display pulse dynamics and build charts
Systolic and diastolic pressure for indicator control and report generation
Percentage of blood oxygen saturation, to track respiratory function and promptly alert about concerning values
Blood glucose concentration for indicator monitoring and report generation
Body mass for tracking changes and calculating derived indicators

Reading is used only to display your measurements in the app interface: history list, charts and summary reports. Writing is needed so that measurements taken directly in HealthStream are saved back to Health Connect and become available to other apps at your choice.

All data is processed exclusively on your device. Data may come from manual input, from the system Health Connect storage, and from portable medical devices connected via Bluetooth (BLE). It is stored in the protected Health Connect storage and in the app\'s local database. HealthStream does not send medical data to external servers and does not use it for training AI models.

Your data is not shared with third parties, advertising networks, credit bureaus or analytics services. The app does not perform cloud synchronization and does not require an internet connection. Data goes into Health Connect and spreads only among the apps you grant access to yourself.

When a record is deleted by the user inside HealthStream, it is flagged with a soft-delete marker (is_removed = true) in the app\'s local database and is physically removed from the system Health Connect storage if that record was created by the HealthStream app itself. If data created by third-party apps and previously loaded from Health Connect is deleted, it is hidden locally inside HealthStream only (soft delete) and remains in Health Connect and in third-party apps. To physically delete all local app data, clear the storage in Android settings (\u201cSettings\u201d → \u201cApps\u201d → \u201cHealthStream\u201d → \u201cStorage\u201d → \u201cClear data\u201d) or uninstall the app.
You can revoke permissions at any time: open \u201cSettings\u201d → \u201cApps\u201d → \u201cHealthStream\u201d → \u201cPermissions\u201d or the Health Connect permission management.
For any questions related to processing of personal and medical data, contact pavel.shoplik@yandex.ru.
